\section{\texttt{JsonConversationStore}}
\label{class:feedback_intelligence_agent.memory.JsonConversationStore}\index{Classes!JsonConversationStore}

Conversation store that persists one JSON file per conversation.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
JsonConversationStore(self, root: str | Path) -> None
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{root}] \texttt{str \textbar{} Path}, required.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Details}Files are written as \texttt{\{root\}/\allowbreak{}\{conversation\_\allowbreak{}id\}.\allowbreak{}json} with indented JSON, so conversations are easy to inspect, diff, and replay locally.
